title: Evangelism
definition: Evangelism is the faithful proclamation of the Gospel of Jesus Christ to those who need salvation.
summary: Evangelism shares the good news of Christ so people may repent, believe, and be saved.
christFocus: Jesus is the message of evangelism and the risen Lord who sends His people to bear witness to Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Evangelism is not winning arguments or pressuring people into religious decisions. It is the faithful sharing of the Gospel: who God is, what sin has done, what Christ has accomplished, and how sinners are called to repent and believe.

The power of evangelism is not human personality but the message of Christ and the work of the Holy Spirit. Believers speak, pray, love, and bear witness, trusting God to open hearts.

Evangelism belongs to the mission of the Church and the life of discipleship. Those who have received grace are called to make that grace known.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people around us are spiritually lost, wounded, confused, or trusting in false hopes. Evangelism matters because Christ is the only Savior, and faith comes by hearing the word of Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pray for opportunities, speak the Gospel clearly, and love people sincerely. Do not let fear silence your witness. Share Christ with humility, courage, and dependence on the Spirit.
